title: ‘BTS Recipe Book Volume 2’: K-Pop Superstars Break Down Even More of Their Favorite Korean Dishes
summary: Dropping on March 2, 2027, BTS Recipe Book is available for preorder.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

This past September, Running Press released volume 1 of the BTS cookbook . And now, the publisher announced volume 2 is set for release in spring 2027, in partnership with the K-pop superstars — including RM, Jin, SUGA, j-hope, Jimin, V and Jung Kook.

$30.00

preorder Now On Amazon

Priced at $30 on Amazon, BTS Recipe Book Volume 2: Book of Tasty Stories gets its inspiration from the supergroup’s album eras with recipes for Korean cuisine, such as egg rice with soy sauce, kimchi stew, seaweed rice rolls, spicy stir-fried chicken and other dishes.

The cookbook, which is available starting Tuesday (March 2, 2027), is best for those who want to experience the group’s favorite dishes. Additionally, the publishing company has the second volume of a BTS lyrics book titled BTS Lyrics Inside Volume 2 , which is also available with release on the same date.

And if you’re an Amazon Prime member , you can buy now and BTS Recipe Book Volume 2 will be delivered to your home in less than two days, thanks to Prime Delivery, when it’s released to the public.

PREORDER

'BTS Recipe Book Volume 2: Book of Tasty Stories'

by BTS

Release date: March 2, 2027

BTS Recipe Book Volume 2 is also available as a Kindle ebook . It’s less expensive than the physical hardcover book, as it’s on sale at $14.99 (was $30). The ebook version also comes out on Tuesday (March 2). If you buy now, it will be delivered digitally to your Kindle or Kindle mobile app upon release.

Meanwhile, the cookbook comes with QR codes for fans to get more out of the cooking with BTS experience, including exclusive videos, tips for creating Korean cuisine and other features.

Available for preorder, BTS Recipe Book Volume 2: Book of Tasty Stories by BTS is priced at $30 on Amazon. It drops on Tuesday (March 2).

Additionally, the cookbook is available for preorder at BookShop.org for $27.96 (was $30) , while it can be preordered at Barnes & Noble priced at $30 .
